This role is the Primary **People & Culture Leader and** visible face of **Human Resources at t

the plant floor and leadership discussions. --------------------

* Analyze turnover, attendance, staffing, engagement, workforce demographics, and other people data to identify trends and translate insights into practical recommendations for plant leadership.
* Apply digital tools, automation, and artificial intelligence responsibly to improve People & Culture insights, efficiency, associate experience, and decision-making while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data stewardship.
* Ensure People & Culture practices and documentation are consistent with company policies, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and employment and labor requirem

* Strengthen leader capability in performance management, associate engagement, development conversations, conflict resolution, and consistent application of People & Culture practices.

postingQuotes: Senior Director, Commercial Manufacturing and Operations
The Senior Director, Commercial Manufacturing & Operations is Olema’s senior leader accountable for building, scaling and governing the commercial manufacturing and supply platform for palazestrant.

Provide business and operational oversight of commercial DS and DP manufacturing, partnering with CMC Technical, Quality and Regulatory on registrational readiness, PPQ, process validation and the transition to commercial supply.
Coordinate batch disposition with Quality and the release of finished goods to the 3PL.

We expect top-line data from OPERA-01, our ongoing Phase 3 trial of palazestrant as a monotherapy in patients with second- or third-line ER+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer (MBC), in Q1 2027 which, if positive, could lead to our first potential approval and commercial launch in 2028.
Commercial Supply Strategy & Launch Readiness

We expect top-line data from OPERA-01, our ongoing Phase 3 trial of palazestrant as a monotherapy in patients with second- or third-line ER+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer (MBC), in Q1 2027 which, if positive, could lead to our first potential approval and commercial launch in 2028.

We recently presented encouraging Phase 1 monotherapy data from this program across multiple solid tumor types, are advancing patient enrollment in the ongoing combination arms in MBC, and expect to initiate a Phase 1 study of OP-3136 in combination with Bayer’s darolutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer by the end of this year.
Strategic and hands-on: shapes the commercial supply platform and does the daily work a lean, build-from-scratch organization requires.

**Senior Manager, Global External Manufacturing (GEM) Oral-Solid Dosage (OSD)** supports uninterrupted supply of Gilead’s clinical and commercial products through execution of manufacturing campaigns within our global external contract manufacturing network, while ensuring compliance with cGMP, regulatory requirements, and environmental, health, and safety legislations.

The role requires collaboration with the Technical Development, Quality, Regulatory, Analytical, Supply Chain, and Product & Portfolio Strategy organizations within PDM to ensure successful technology transfer/validation, commercialization, launch, routine supply, and proactive management of changes across the product lifecycle.

* Enables timely resolution of complex technical issues associated with manufacturing, product quality and/or compliance, including finished product trending, continued process verification, out-of-trend, and out-of-specification investigations, change management, handling of deviations and product complaints.

The role requires collaboration with the Technical Development, Quality, Regulatory, Analytical, Supply Chain, and Product & Portfolio Strategy organizations within PDM to ensure successful technology transfer/validation, commercialization, launch, routine supply, and proactive management of changes across the product lifecycle.

* May represent GEM on one or more cross-functional PDM Development or Commercial teams with responsibility for proactively managing product strategy across the life cycle from clinical supply to commercial product launch, to routine supply, and finally to sunset or divestiture of the product.
Our workforce reflects these values and celebrates the individuals who make up our growing team.
Benefits include company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans\*.
* Identifies and facilitates execution of continuous improvement initiatives to reduce costs, improve quality, increase efficiency, and ensure sustainability of supply.
